architecture.approach: Client-side only. One skeleton primitive and one empty-state component are added under components/ui/, then consumed by route-level loading/error files and by the existing event and ticket screens. Optimistic updates are a thin layer over the existing Convex mutations: the client writes an optimistic entry, the server stays authoritative, and a rejection rolls the entry back and announces the reason. No Convex function, validator, or authorization check changes.

components.name: components/ui/skeleton.tsx
components.description: The single shimmer implementation; reduced-motion aware and aria-hidden.

components.name: components/ui/empty-state.tsx
components.description: Reason plus optional action, used by tickets and explore results.

components.name: components/skeletons/event-skeleton.tsx
components.description: Event page placeholder shared by the route loading file and the page query state.

components.name: components/skeletons/tickets-skeleton.tsx
components.description: Ticket grid placeholder shared by the route loading file and the page query state.

components.name: components/route-error.tsx
components.description: Shared recovery surface: announced, retry, working home link, no internal detail.

components.name: app/(public)/events/[slug]/loading.tsx
components.description: Route-level skeleton for the event page.

components.name: app/(public)/events/[slug]/_components/register-modal.tsx
components.description: Pending state, double-submit guard, inline announced failure.

components.name: app/(main)/my-tickets/page.tsx
components.description: Optimistic cancellation with rollback, skeleton during query load, shared empty state.

components.name: app/(public)/explore/page.tsx
components.description: Empty results use the shared empty-state component.

dataModel.flowDescription: No persistence change. Optimistic entries live only in the Convex client cache for the lifetime of the request; the server remains the source of truth, and every optimistic entry is either confirmed or rolled back. No table, index, or validator is added or altered.

dependencies.name: Convex optimistic updates
dependencies.notes: The installed Convex client must expose optimistic updates for the mutation path in use.

dependencies.name: BP-015 live region
dependencies.notes: useAnnounce from components/a11y/live-region.tsx is the only announcement channel; no toast-only fallback.

performanceConsiderations.strategy: Skeletons reuse the final layout tokens; CLS asserted at 0.02 on both routes.
One skeleton module and one empty-state module, both static blocks; size measured against the 5KB budget.
Optimistic entries are client-cache only; no server contract changes.

risks.description: Optimistic state diverges from the server after a partial failure.
risks.mitigation: Roll back on any error and reconcile on settle; keep the optimistic layer to a single mutation wrapper.

risks.description: Skeleton layout differs from real content, reintroducing shift.
risks.mitigation: Build skeletons from the same Tailwind spacing tokens as the real components and assert CLS in the performance check.

risks.description: Error boundary swallows a genuine defect.
risks.mitigation: Log to the console in development and keep the boundary at the route segment.
